title: Barry Sacramento · Interior 2.5D Fly-Through
provenance: Construction corridor reuses the existing Barry Minkow opening corridor plate. Walking figures and shadows are separate procedural vector illustration layers modeled from the supplied storyboard composition; not archival photography.

motion.principle: continuous forward/downward camera travel through one coherent scene; near clipped architecture moves fastest, background moves slowest, people and shadows occupy separate depth planes; no orbiting or lateral dance

layers.src: derived from corridor plate at runtime
layers.role: mid and near left/right/top occluder planes
